step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents Telefónica Tech's AI Suite. Multi-account provisioning and governance are handled using AWS Service Catalog and AWS Control Tower, while customer data is stored encrypted at rest in Amazon S3. The backend compute layer consists of Node.js containers managed by Amazon ECS, fronted by an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Application metadata, user info, and ML hyperparameters are stored in Amazon DocumentDB, while container coordination and pub/sub messaging utilize ElastiCache for Redis. Data profiling and ETL processing are handled by AWS Glue, migrating away from legacy Amazon EMR tasks.
